With `--recursive=y`, `check()` calls `_discover_files(files_or_modules)` to turn directories into a list of files/packages.\n2. Then `_iterate_file_descrs` → `_expand_files` → `expand_modules` on the discovered files.\n\nIn `_discover_files`, the files yielded from a non-package directory are never checked against `ignore`, `ignore_patterns`, or `ignore_paths`. Only the `root` directory is checked. So:\n\n- Pattern `^src/gen/.*$` doesn't match directory `src/gen` itself (because the regex requires `src/gen/` + at least one more char).\n- Therefore the directory isn't skipped, and the files inside are yielded without any ignore check → bug.\n\nNow, what is the actual upstream fix?
